places.name: Vilnius Old Town (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, Vilnius Old Town is a historic area with cobblestone streets, baroque architecture, and vibrant culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot to discover hidden gems.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.name: Gediminas Tower & Hill
places.ai_summary: A historic tower offering panoramic views of Vilnius, located on a hill accessible by foot or funicular.

opening_hours.notes: Funicular operates during opening hours.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning city views.

places.name: Vilnius Cathedral & Bell Tower
places.ai_summary: An iconic symbol of Vilnius, the Cathedral and its Bell Tower are masterpieces of neoclassical architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events or services.

places.place_tip: Climb the Bell Tower for a panoramic view of the city.

places.name: St. Anne’s Church
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of Gothic architecture in Vilnius, known for its intricate facade and rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the interior details and the nearby Bernardine Gardens.

places.name: Vilnius University Courtyards
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and historic complex, the courtyards of Vilnius University are perfect for a peaceful stroll.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during university events.

places.place_tip: Explore the various buildings and don't miss the university library.

places.name: Presidential Palace
places.ai_summary: The official residence of the President of Lithuania, this palace is an important historical and political site.

opening_hours.notes: Check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Cathedral Square for a complete experience.

places.name: Uzupis Republic (Art District)
places.ai_summary: A quirky and artistic neighborhood, Uzupis is known for its bohemian atmosphere and creative spirit.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot to fully appreciate the art and culture.

places.place_tip: Visit the local galleries and enjoy the street art.

places.name: Gate of Dawn (Aušros Vartai)
places.ai_summary: A significant religious and historical site, the Gate of Dawn is famous for its icon of the Virgin Mary.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the religious significance; dress modestly.

places.place_tip: Take part in the morning prayers for a unique experience.

places.name: Three Crosses Hill Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint in Vilnius, offering stunning views of the city and the Neris River.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the view.

attribution.title: Gothic Vilnius Cathedral
attribution.author: Taken from the Vl. Zahorski book Katedra Wilenska (1904), page 15.
attribution.description: Vilnius Cathedral in Gothic architectural style in 1530.

places.name: Bernardine Gardens
places.ai_summary: A serene and picturesque park in Vilnius, perfect for a relaxing stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: Well-maintained paths and gardens.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby St. Anne’s Church and the Vilnius University Courtyards.

places.name: National Museum of Lithuania
places.ai_summary: The largest museum in Lithuania, showcasing the country's history, culture, and art.

opening_hours.notes: Check for temporary exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for in-depth knowledge of the exhibits.
places.address: National Museum of Lithuania, Vilnius, Lithuania

places.name: Town Hall Square
places.ai_summary: The main square in Vilnius, surrounded by historic buildings and vibrant with city life.

opening_hours.notes: A great place to start exploring the city.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the outdoor cafes.

places.name: Palace of the Grand Dukes of Lithuania
places.ai_summary: A magnificent palace showcasing the history of the Lithuanian state and its rulers.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum inside for a deep dive into Lithuanian history.
places.address: Palace of the Grand Dukes, Vilnius, Lithuania

places.name: Vilnius Street Art Route
places.ai_summary: Explore the vibrant street art scene of Vilnius through this curated route.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the artists and the stories behind the art.

places.name: Literatai Street
places.ai_summary: A charming street in Vilnius, known for its literary history and artistic atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: A great place to explore local art and literature.

places.place_tip: Visit the small galleries and bookshops along the street.

places.name: St. Casimir Church
places.ai_summary: A beautiful baroque church in Vilnius, known for its stunning interior and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Check for choir performances and special events.

places.place_tip: Admire the altar and the unique architecture.

places.name: KGB Museum (Museum of Occupations & Freedom Fights)
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the victims of the Soviet occupation, located in the former KGB headquarters.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are recommended.

places.place_tip: Allow time for the emotional impact of the exhibits.

places.name: Subačiaus Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint in Vilnius, offering beautiful views of the old town and the Neris River.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and enjoy the view.

places.name: Neris River Walkway
places.ai_summary: A pleasant walkway along the Neris River, ideal for a leisurely stroll or a bike ride.

opening_hours.notes: Well-lit and safe for evening walks.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the view of the old town from the riverbank.

places.name: Evening Lights in Cathedral Square
places.ai_summary: Experience the magical atmosphere of Cathedral Square in the evening, with beautiful lights and lively ambiance.

opening_hours.notes: A great place to relax and people-watch.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby cafes and enjoy the local cuisine.
